MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Clear sealant and metal-repair epoxy feel useful alongside my duct tape and vinyl cement because they offer practical ways to seal gaps or make durable repairs.",
    "Adhesive hook-and-loop strips fit my interest in securing equipment while allowing access later, complementing my tape and quick-disconnect connectors."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Woodworking tape, a fishing magnet, and a well-pump gauge require specific jobs that my past purchases do not establish.",
    "The washers require a confirmed size, while six cartridges of white sealant exceed my current needs; the smaller clear-sealant pack feels more useful.",
    "Kitchen-and-bath caulk and bulk disposable masks do not address a repair need I currently have."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying repair supplies seems to have been taken as interest in almost any workshop or maintenance product.",
    "My tape and hose-clamp purchases seem to have been stretched into assumptions about woodworking and well-pump work."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The purpose of a product matters more to me than sharing a brand or broad repair theme with something I bought.",
    "Quantity, color, dimensions, and operating range can determine whether an otherwise relevant supply fits my job.",
    "My purchases span several years, so an older purchase alone does not mean I am still working on that task."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognized my interest in practical repairs but assumed specific projects and quantities without enough evidence."
}
